header.title: Papyrus Deir el-Medineh 1: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Medical papyri
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:egy:tla:sawmedizin:papyrus-deir-el-medineh-1:translit, from the Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (2018), in Simon Schweitzer's AED-TEI (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. notes.1.27: mn and mn,t are the placeholders 'N (male)' and 'N (female)' for the patient and his mother. sfḫ, literally 'loosing', is uncertain here. nmj may be the same as the nmjꜥ addressed in the preceding context, perhaps a being in the sky. mnḥ may be wax or papyrus. Line 27: the last clause is literally 'against the one that they will come against him'; uncertain.
notes.1.55: mn/mn,t are placeholders for the patient and his mother. Line 55: gs-mꜣꜥ, 'the true side', is unexplained. Lines 56-57 are heavily restored; wjꜣ (restored in 56, partly preserved in 57) is of uncertain meaning, and 'bark' is only a guess. Line 57 ends in a broken word nm[...]. Line 58: whꜣnꜣ is taken as whn 'overturn'; ḫnw 'abode' and jsj 'tomb' are probable readings.

nodes.text: As for every *sfḫ* and every evil thing that would come against [N born of] N, they shall be warded off from the one against whom they would come.
This spell is to be recited at the ear [...]
Likewise the *nmj* that is in writing on *mnḥ*,
[...] everything that happens, through the spell for opening what is sealed.
Book of the temple [of the head].

As for the head of N born of N, it is the head of Osiris-Wennefer, [on which] [...] [the divine uraeus] [is placed]; they are spitting fire, so as to [make] [your] [bark(?)] [the head] [of N born of N] like Osiris.
If you do not [...] (wjꜣ) yourself [truly] [for] N born of N, I will burn your ba, I will destroy you, I will fell you [...] in you, I will cause you to be [seized] ... [...]

If you are a god, I will overturn your abode, I will smash your tomb in which you are, I will not [allow] [...], [so as] [not] [to let] you mingle as an excellent ba, so as not to let you enter in the following of [Horus].
